name: Solo Ball
detail: Needs wrist surgery and will take a medical redshirt, sitting out all of 2026-27 and aiming to return in 2027-28.

name: Brandon McCoy Jr.
detail: The five-star freshman tore his ACL on Michigan's summer trip to Lithuania and is done for 2026-27.

name: Donnie Freeman
detail: The Syracuse transfer tore his Achilles in a noncontact workout injury in early July and has already had surgery.

name: Marcus Allen
detail: After beating lymphoma, the junior forward tore his ACL during summer workouts in the Bahamas, ending his planned comeback this year.

name: Melvin Council Jr.
detail: Broke a bone in his right foot in practice on Nov. 9 and was set for surgery; Bill Self hopes he is back around conference play and he may miss the rest of nonconference.

name: JT Toppin
detail: Still rehabbing the ACL he tore last February, with no timetable set for his return to games as of late October.

name: Ty Rodgers
detail: The Illinois transfer had surgery after a workout injury in June and is out indefinitely, with the 2026-27 season in doubt.
source: Sports Illustrated (Boise State Broncos On SI)

name: AJ Dancler
detail: Hurt his knee in summer workouts, had surgery in late August, and will miss the whole 2026-27 season.

name: Jaylen Carey
detail: The Tennessee transfer was suspended indefinitely by Dennis Gates for a team-rules violation just before the opener; he also missed both exhibitions.
